newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo firms on weaker mark.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo firms on weaker mark.

text.p: The escudo gained against a weaker German mark on Wednesday, aided by a European Commission report strengthening Portugal's claims to a place in the single currency.
The Commission said that Portugal, along with most European Union members, would meet the three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) budget deficit target, a key criterion for entry.
The escudo was at 100.40/42 to the mark against its 100.65/70 opening.
